page.overview:
Who is Les Feuilles?

Les Feuilles takes the form of tiny insect-like Stands with helmet-shaped heads and suction cup feet, covered in polka-dots and the number 11. Their presence as several smaller beings is similar to that of Harvest, Bad Company and Metallica.

Les Feuilles are green in the colored manga.

Les Feuilles are an unusual Stand in that they have no true user, meaning anyone is free to use them if they know how. They do not have any combat ability whatsoever but are extremely useful to the denizens of "Shakedown Road" in order to set up crimes.

Les Feuilles hide under the fallen gingko leaves on the road and promenade. If enough leaves connect to form a path, anything and anyone that touches the leaves is instantly transported from one end of the path to the other.
